sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; isolated junior member purchases from May 2022 lack conviction, market sentiment is balanced (AAII neutral, Fear/Greed at 60), and no recent news data available.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 181 crisis regime, NFP event today) combined with critical earnings binary in 5 days creates severe risk environment for STE.

debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 5 days + VIX crisis regime (181) + inverted yield curve + multiple overbought oscillators with no fresh momentum crossovers + zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
